newsitem.title: RUSSIA: FIGURE SKATING-GERMAN PAIR SKATE ON TO CHAMPIONS SERIES FINAL.
newsitem.headline: FIGURE SKATING-GERMAN PAIR SKATE ON TO CHAMPIONS SERIES FINAL.

text.p: Germans Mandy Woetzel and Ingo Steuer skated into the ISU Champions Series final by winning the pairs event in the Baileys Cup of Russia on Friday with an almost flawless performance.
Lying second after the short programme, the former European champions won the free skating to take gold, $30,000 in prize money and 12 Champions Series points.

They move to the top of the overall rankings with a maxium 24 points from their two scoring competitions. It was their third win in the Series, the final of which is set for Hamilton, Ontario, from February 28 to March 2.

"I don't like to skate last and I was so nervous that I was shaking," Woetzel said. "But with this win we know our programmes are good and that we can win with them. Our next big competition before the final is the Europeans."
Tthe European Championships will be held in Paris from January 19 to 26.

Overnight leaders Marina Eltsova and Andrei Bushkov of Russia dropped to second place after two falls in the free skating. But this was a non-points scoring competition for the world champions, already certain of their place in the four-strong field in February's final..
European champions Oksana Kazakova and Artur Dmitriev, also from Russia, remained third but scored seven Champions Series points to move them up to third overall and ensure a place in the final.
